narrative.overview:
The user-pinned Empryo reference now informs distinct compositions rather than a uniform card wrapper: unboxed reading, compact direct-label comparisons, maintained charts, explicit relationships, task status groups, object selection and chapter orientation. The [whole-site foundation](docs/design/empryo-foundation.md) and [measured tokens](docs/design/empryo-tokens.json) govern the reference; this document records the implemented subset, not a whole-site feature port.

The official DSH application owns navigation, settings and appearance. Plugin content uses the measured Undertow light/dark palette, local Recursive typography and Lucide outlines. OpenUI remains the chart/table/Markdown renderer; React Flow and ELK supply the relationship canvas and layout. Original text, source cells, qualifications and the single conversation display selector remain reachable.
keyCharacteristics: Unboxed prose and compact comparisons share quiet Undertow surfaces.
Composition follows explicit source structure rather than decorative tiles.
Complete tables, records and relationship sources remain inspectable.
One host-header selector controls presentation, original and comparison modes.

rules.name: Scoped Theme Preference
rules.body: User-selected data-only theme controls IEP and compatible scoped surfaces; official application preferences remain owned by DSH.

rules.name: The Source Stays Reachable Rule
rules.body: Visualizations supplement source content. Keep qualifications, exact selected cells, complete tables, original records and raw/comparison access available.

dos: Do choose composition from explicit source structure while keeping prose in document order.
Do use the host's resolved scheme and the single conversation-header selector.
Do retain exact source strings, units, exclusions, qualifications and complete sources.
Do keep the local Recursive font and OFL together.
Do distinguish browser review from installed official DSH acceptance.
donts: Don't wrap every paragraph or compact comparison in a card.
Don't invent data, graph edges, task status or execution success for visual effect.
Don't add per-output theme or display selectors; use shared Settings and conversation controls.
Don't promote fixture controls, private report content or detector preferences into product rules.
Don't ship reference screenshots or infer app acceptance from browser captures.
